label: IoT Sensor Simulator
info:
Generates one simulated sensor reading every second and preprocesses it before reaching the Express backend.

Flow:  inject (1s) -> function (generate) -> function (preprocess_minute) -> [http request (POST /api/data), http request (POST /api/processed, every 60th tick)] -> debug

preprocess_minute implements the preprocessing pipeline: physics-informed validation (every tick), then buffering + missing-data detection + Hampel-filter outlier capping + one-minute aggregation + data-quality scoring (every 60th tick). See the design document for the full rationale.

NOTE on the http request nodes' URLs:
- Running Node-RED NATIVELY (npx node-red / node-red, no container) -> use http://localhost:3000/...
- Running Node-RED INSIDE DOCKER (e.g. the official nodered/node-red image) -> 'localhost' means the container itself, not your host machine, so use http://host.docker.internal:3000/... instead (Docker Desktop's special DNS name for reaching the host).
